description: Round 7 (expressions family, seeds 19001-19015, 30000 cases; the tree of the second performance pass merged with the fuzz-harness fixes, 1cd373e): inside an array or hash literal (also the variadic arguments of dump(), which Twig passes as `...[...]`, and the arguments of a macro call), the `odd` and `even` tests raised the TypeError of their `%` at an earlier line than PHP (P44, fixed). Twig compiles them inline (OddTest, EvenTest: `(node % 2 != 0)`, `(node % 2 == 0)`); PHP's ZEND_MOD takes CG(zend_lineno) as its last operand left it, the literal `2` written right after the node, so the error reports the last debug marker inside the node (the name `s` on line 2), while twig-rs reported the line of the literal or of the node's first token: Codegen::test() took the line state the node left for the `2`. The `%` operator written out, `divisible by` and the tests outside a literal matched. Not from the performance pass: the tree before it (a258816) reports the same lines. Minimised from x19005-00668-logic (1 raw case). The first 12 vectors were marked known mismatches until the fix; the variants after the first 9 controls were recorded with the fix (the tree before it reports line 1 for each). Every vector must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".
